name: TenantSafe
roles: Application Security Engineer I · Product Security Engineer
headline: A document ID is not permission.
description: Reproduce a cross-tenant object lookup, then inspect the authorization that stops it.
guide: Request South’s budget as Alice. The vulnerable lookup allows it; the patched path returns 404 with no data.
Request North’s plan as viewer with update selected. The patched path returns 403.
Run the local server to test actual cookie-authenticated document routes. The vulnerable route exists only behind an explicit local lab switch.
limits: All documents are fictional. The public comparator accepts synthetic perspectives; actual server-side identity binding is exercised by the separate local HTTP server.
